contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Game concept and the detailed mission specification: seven carriages, HP/energy/inventory, turn-based fights with announced intents, fight/encounter/supply forks, one-of-two upgrades, a final confrontation and two endings.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Implemented the rules engine and the trilingual interface (EN/FR/ES), wrote the fairy-tale prose, drew the inline SVG wagons and characters, synthesized the audio, balanced the game with seeded simulations, and verified it with headless tests and two full browser playthroughs.

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
contributions.summary: One balance consult on the final numbers: found the game too lenient and proposed +4 damage on telegraphed blows; the proposal was simulated, made careful play unwinnable, and was not adopted (details in DELIVERY.md).
